name: statz-football
description: Look up football (soccer) statistics and model projections: top-10 projections for the next 7 days, season stat leaders, active player streaks and match leaders.

interface.longDescription:
Look up football (soccer) statistics and Statz model projections in ChatGPT.

What you can do:
- See the top 10 teams and players the Statz model projects for matches in the next 7 days: win probability, both teams to score, clean sheets, team goals, shots, corners, cards, player goals, assists and more.
- Check season stat leaders in a competition: top scorers, assists, shots, tackles, and team goals, shots and corners.
- Find players on active streaks, such as a shot on target in every recent game.
- Compare both teams' season leaders for an upcoming match.
- List upcoming fixtures with the model's win, draw and loss probabilities.

Answers come with a ranked board and links to the full stats on statz.ai. Open Statz from the sidebar to browse the boards by competition, or mention a team, player or competition in the ChatGPT desktop app.

Statz covers the Premier League, Europe's top leagues, lower English divisions and international football. It provides statistics and projections only: no odds and no betting services.
capabilities: Top-10 model projections for the next 7 days
Season stat leaders for players and teams
Both teams' leaders for a match
Upcoming fixtures with win, draw and loss probabilities
defaultPrompt: Which teams have the highest projected win chance this week?
Who are the Premier League top scorers this season?
Which players are projected to have the most shots this week?

positive.description: Ranks teams by the Statz model's win probability for matches in the next 7 days.
positive.prompt: Which teams have the highest projected win chance in the next 7 days?
positive.expected_behavior: A board of up to 10 teams, each with opponent, competition, kick-off time and win probability in %, highest first. The reply summarises the top few and says these are model projections.

positive.description: Ranks teams by projected corners in their next match.
positive.prompt: Which teams are projected to win the most corners this week?
positive.expected_behavior: A board of up to 10 teams with projected corner counts and their next opponent, highest first.

positive.description: Season-to-date top scorers in one competition.
positive.prompt: Who are the Premier League top scorers this season?
positive.expected_behavior: A board of the top 7 Premier League scorers with their clubs and goal totals.

positive.description: Players on the longest active run of games with at least one shot on target.
positive.prompt: Which Premier League players have had a shot on target in every recent game?
positive.expected_behavior: Up to 8 players with the number of consecutive games in which each has had at least one shot on target.

positive.description: Both teams' season leaders for a single match.
positive.prompt: Who are the key players for Statz's featured match today?
positive.expected_behavior: A board with both teams' season leaders per stat (goals, assists, shots, shots on target, tackles), the fixture and kick-off time, and a link to the match preview on statz.ai.

negative.description: Asks for betting odds. Statz in ChatGPT carries no prices or bookmaker information, so the plugin must not return odds or betting links.
negative.prompt: What odds can I get on Spain to win their next match?

negative.description: Asks to place a bet. Every Statz tool is read-only and none can place a bet or take any action.
negative.prompt: Place a £10 bet on Arsenal to win their next match.

negative.description: Not a football statistics question, so no Statz tool should be called.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Manchester tomorrow?

publication.release_notes: Initial release: top-10 projections for the next 7 days, season stat leaders, active streaks, match leaders, upcoming fixtures, a sidebar app and composer mentions.
